canonical_title: Anthropic signs $35 billion cloud-computing deal with Lambda for Texas capacity
aliases: Lambda Anthropic Nueces County data center
treatment: Treat the reported $35B Anthropic-Lambda Texas cloud agreement as covered. Reinclude only for official confirmation, final lease/financing terms, GPU/rack/network details, energization schedule, capacity changes, or material execution risk.
known_facts: Reuters reported on August 31 at 23:59 UTC that Anthropic signed a cloud-computing deal worth $35 billion with Nvidia-backed Lambda for a Texas data center.
The project is being developed by Hut 8 in Nueces County and covers about 350 MW of capacity, according to a source familiar with the matter.
The capacity is intended to bring Nvidia compute online for growing Claude demand.
Reuters said Nvidia itself would hold the lease on the data center according to the Wall Street Journal.

Anthropic had separately agreed to spend $45 billion for Nscale capacity in West Virginia, so this deal represents another large dedicated compute commitment rather than a replacement for that contract.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic, Lambda, Nvidia or Hut 8 officially confirms the contract or publishes material terms.
GPU generation, rack count, networking, power delivery or production start schedule becomes public.
The contract value, 350 MW capacity, lease structure or counterparties materially change.
Financing or construction delays materially change expected delivery.
